floorPlans.label: Nshama Camden official apartment plans
floorPlans.introduction: Compare the developer’s published one-, two- and three-bedroom apartment layouts.
floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Ranges follow the printed minimum and maximum figures. The published totals for some Camden families differ from the sum of the displayed suite and balcony figures. The original totals are retained. Confirm the size of the specific apartment.

review.gallery: 7 project renders from Nshama’s own live gallery. Two photos from the 18 August 2026 DLD album for project 3839, mirrored by Continental Club. Another frame in the album identifies Camden on the site board. Inspection record https://continentalclub.ae/project/camden-town-square/.
review.location: Project location confirmed on brochure physical page 8 and compared with the published building point. The display isolates the complete master-plan panel. The six time estimates are from page 6 and describe the community.
review.floorPlans: All 6 original physical pages of the official apartment plan PDF. Area tables checked visually. The published totals for some Camden families differ from the sum of the displayed suite and balcony figures. The original totals are retained.

unavailable: Surveyed visitor entrance, completed-building photography and as-built individual unit schedules.
